name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Kind of Blue
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 KIND OF BLUE
source:
As the game begins, we learn that Yoko Misoni, Saburou's invaluable assistant, has left the firm. Even a tough guy like Jinguuji feels the pain and misses his former employee. Despite the pangs, Saburou trudges ahead with cases and detective work. The new scenario in Kind of Blue places the super sleuth on assignment against a crime boss and on the hunt for a missing singer from a local jazz bar. As usual, portly police detective Sanzo Kumano provides support and advice during the course of the game. 

[From [url=http://www.ncsxshop.com/cgi-bin/shop/SLPM-65576.html]NCSX[/url]]
translation:
故事开始时，我们得知神宫寺三郎不可或缺的助手御苑洋子已经离开事务所。即便是神宫寺这样的硬汉，也会为此感到痛苦，思念昔日的搭档。尽管心中刺痛，他仍拖着沉重的脚步继续接案调查。《Kind of Blue》的全新剧情中，这位名侦探将受命对抗一名犯罪头目，并寻找当地爵士酒吧失踪的歌手。与往常一样，身材魁梧的刑警熊野参造会在游戏过程中提供支援和建议。

[摘自[url=http://www.ncsxshop.com/cgi-bin/shop/SLPM-65576.html]NCSX[/url]]
